model.name: gemma3:4b
model.family_caveat: gemma3, not gemma4. Acceptable only because the pilot contrasts SE/AST/HML WITHIN this one model; results are not poolable with the gemma4 screens.

prompts.system_prompt: You are a careful reasoner. Read the state exactly as given and answer the question. Follow the requested answer format exactly.
prompts.instructions:
You are given a formal description of a state, and a question about it.
Everything needed to answer is stated. Nothing is implied by convention.

endpoint.name: CONTRAST (Endpoint B)
endpoint.scoring: pair BOTH-CORRECT; truncated responses unscored and drop the pair whole

caveats: 8/12 sits on the UPPER EDGE of the acceptable band and outside the preferred 5-7.
Large half-to-half swing (3/6 then 5/6) means the point estimate is unstable at N=6 per half.
OPERAND_ORDER is 4/4 -- saturated. Discriminating power comes only from QUANTIFIER_ORDER (2/4) and IMPLICATION_DIRECTION (2/4). One third of pilot pairs are expected to be non-discriminating.
